doc.title: Buddy Tate interviewed by Michael Woods, Scottsdale, Arizona, March 3, 1995

title: Identifying a 1940 Basie band photograph
summary: Tate looks at a photo with Monk Rowe and Milt Fillius, trying to place it and naming the players.

story.theme_name: Who was in the band: naming sidemen and personnel
story.community_name: Who played in the band: reciting personnel

blocks.x: Treating people’s wives and things — MR: I’ve got a picture here, and see what you can remember about that? 1940?
I sure do, yes sir. That was made I’m trying to remember where. Let’s see Page is in here, Walter Page. MR: Do you remember that night?
I’m trying to see. No I was thinking this would be made at Treasure Island in Los Angeles, remember when they had Treasure Island in 1939? You people too young. MF: San Francisco.
San Francisco, that’s right. No it wasn’t there. I don’t know where this was.
If it says the year maybe you could — MR: I think it says Savoy Ballroom, New York.
